sentences.zh: 太尉以下各就面北褥位立定，禮直官贊：「拜。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor and those below each took their appointed kneeling mats facing north; the ritual supervisor announced: 'Bow.'
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor and those below each took their kneeling mats facing north; the ritual supervisor announced: 'Bow.'

sentences.zh: 」在位官俱再拜，訖，太尉率中書令侍郎奉冊匣升殿，登歌樂作，至殿上，冊匣置於食案之前，仍設褥位，樂止。

translations.literal: All officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, the Grand Mentor led the Director and Vice Directors of the Secretariat to bear the register case up the hall; the ascending music sounded; on reaching the hall floor the register case was placed before the food table and a kneeling mat was again set out; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: All officials present bowed twice; when finished, the Grand Mentor led the Director and Vice Directors of the Secretariat to bear the register case up the hall; the ascending music sounded; on the hall floor the register case was placed before the food table and a kneeling mat was set out again; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 次引太尉詣神位前，俯伏，跪，稱：「攝太尉臣某言，謹上加尊諡冊，寶。

translations.literal: Next the Grand Mentor was led before the spirit seat; he prostrated himself, knelt, and declared: 'Your subject [name], Acting Grand Mentor, reverently presents the augmented honorific register and seal.'
translations.idiomatic: Next the Grand Mentor was led before the spirit seat; he prostrated himself, knelt, and declared: 'Your subject [name], Acting Grand Mentor, reverently presents the augmented posthumous register and seal.'

sentences.zh: 」奏訖，俯伏，興，稍西立。

translations.literal: When the declaration was finished, he prostrated himself, rose, and stood slightly to the west.
translations.idiomatic: When the declaration was finished, he prostrated himself, rose, and stood slightly to the west.

sentences.zh: 次引中書令立于冊匣南，舉冊官舉冊，中書令俯伏，跪讀冊，訖，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: Next the Director of the Secretariat was led to stand south of the register case; officials lifting the register raised it; the Director prostrated himself, knelt, and read the register; when finished he prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Director of the Secretariat stood south of the register case; officials lifting the register raised it; the Director prostrated himself, knelt, and read the register; when finished he prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 中書令奉冊匣降自西階，置於床，登歌樂作，置訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The Director of the Secretariat bore the register case down the western steps and placed it on the stand; the ascending music sounded; when it was set in place the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The Director bore the register case down the western steps and placed it on the stand; the ascending music sounded; when it was set in place the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 次引侍中門下侍郎奉寶盝升殿，樂作，置於食案之前。

translations.literal: Next the Attendant-in-Chief and Vice Director of the Gatekeeper Service bore the seal casket up the hall; music sounded; it was placed before the food table.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Attendant-in-Chief and Vice Director of the Gatekeeper Service bore the seal casket up the hall; music sounded; it was placed before the food table.

sentences.zh: 仍設褥位，樂止。

translations.literal: A kneeling mat was again set out; the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: A kneeling mat was set out again; the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 舉寶官舉寶盝，侍中俯伏，跪讀寶，訖，俯伏，興。

translations.literal: Officials lifting the seal raised the seal casket; the Attendant-in-Chief prostrated himself, knelt, and read the seal text; when finished he prostrated himself and rose.
translations.idiomatic: Bearers raised the seal casket; the Attendant-in-Chief prostrated himself, knelt, and read the seal text; when finished he prostrated himself and rose.

sentences.zh: 侍中奉寶盝降自西階，置於床，登歌樂作，置訖，樂止。

translations.literal: The Attendant-in-Chief bore the seal casket down the western steps and placed it on the stand; the ascending music sounded; when it was set in place the music ceased.
translations.idiomatic: The Attendant-in-Chief bore the seal casket down the western steps and placed it on the stand; the ascending music sounded; when it was set in place the music ceased.

sentences.zh: 太尉詣殿門外褥位，再拜，訖，太尉而下俱降階，以次就位。

translations.literal: The Grand Mentor went to the kneeling mat outside the hall door and bowed twice; when finished, the Grand Mentor and those below all descended the steps and took their places in order.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Mentor went to the kneeling mat outside the hall door and bowed twice; when finished, he and those below descended the steps and took their places in order.

sentences.zh: 禮直官贊：「拜。

translations.literal: The ritual supervisor announced: 'Bow.'
translations.idiomatic: The ritual supervisor announced: 'Bow.'

sentences.zh: 」在位官皆再拜，訖，以次出。

translations.literal: All officials in attendance bowed twice; when finished, they departed in order.
translations.idiomatic: All officials present bowed twice; when finished, they departed in order.

sentences.zh: 寺官、署官率拱衛直，舁冊寶床置於冊寶殿，各退。

translations.literal: Officials of the temple and larder bureaus led the palace guards to lift the stands for the registers and seals and place them in the Register and Seal Hall; each then withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Temple and larder officials led the palace guards to lift the stands for the registers and seals and place them in the Register and Seal Hall; each then withdrew.

sentences.zh: 次日，百官稱賀如常儀。

translations.literal: The next day, the hundred officials offered congratulations according to the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the officials offered congratulations according to the usual rite.

sentences.zh: 大定十九年，奉上孝成皇帝諡號。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Dading, the honorific title of Emperor Xiaocheng was presented.
translations.idiomatic: In Dading 19 the court presented the posthumous title of Emperor Xiaocheng.

sentences.zh: 元年十一月十六日，詔曰：「前君乃太祖之長孫，受太宗之遺命，嗣膺神器，十有五年。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the eleventh month of the first year, an edict stated: 'The former ruler was the eldest grandson of Emperor Taizu; he received the testamentary mandate of Emperor Taizong, succeeded to the sacred vessel, and reigned for fifteen years.'
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the eleventh month of the first year an edict stated: 'The former ruler was the eldest grandson of Emperor Taizu; he received Emperor Taizong's testamentary mandate, succeeded to the throne, and reigned for fifteen years.'

sentences.zh: 垂拱仰成，委任勳戚，廢齊國以省徭賦，柔宋人而息兵戈，世格泰和，俗躋仁壽，混車書於南北，一尉候於東西。

translations.literal: He ruled by deferring to accomplished ministers, entrusted affairs to meritorious kinsmen, abolished the Qi state to reduce corvée and taxes, treated the Song people gently and stilled the weapons of war; the age attained great peace, customs rose to benevolence and longevity, chariots and books were united north and south, and frontier posts were made one from east to west.'
translations.idiomatic: He ruled by deferring to accomplished ministers, entrusted affairs to meritorious kinsmen, abolished the Qi state to lighten corvée and taxes, treated the Song people gently and stilled the weapons of war; the age attained great peace, customs rose to benevolence and longevity, chariots and books were united north and south, and frontier posts were made one from east to west.'

sentences.zh: 晚雖淫刑，幾於恣意，冤施弟後，戮及良工，虐不及民，事猶可諫，過之至此，古或有焉。

translations.literal: In his later years, though he used excessive punishments and came near to acting at will—wrongfully punishing his younger brother's widow and killing worthy craftsmen—his cruelty did not reach the common people, and the matter could still be remonstrated against; that excess reached this point is something the ancients sometimes did.'
translations.idiomatic: In his later years he used excessive punishments and came near to acting at will—wrongfully punishing his younger brother's widow and killing worthy craftsmen—yet his cruelty did not reach the common people, and the matter could still be remonstrated against; that excess reached this point is something even the ancients sometimes did.'

sentences.zh: 右丞相岐國王亮不務弼諧，反行篡弑，妄加黜廢，抑損徽稱。

translations.literal: The Chief Councillor on the right, Prince of Qi Liang, did not devote himself to harmonious assistance but instead carried out usurpation and regicide, recklessly imposing dismissal and degradation and diminishing the former ruler's honorific title.'
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor on the right, Prince of Qi Liang, did not devote himself to harmonious assistance but instead carried out usurpation and regicide, recklessly imposing dismissal and degradation and diminishing the former ruler's posthumous title.'

sentences.zh: 遠近傷嗟，神人憤怒，天方悔禍，朕乃繼興，受天下之樂推，居域中之有大。

translations.literal: Near and far mourned and sighed; spirits and men were enraged; Heaven was about to repent of the calamity, and I then succeeded and arose, receiving the willing submission of all under Heaven and occupying the great position within the realm.'
translations.idiomatic: Near and far mourned; spirits and men were enraged; Heaven was about to repent of the calamity, and I then succeeded, receiving the willing submission of all under Heaven and occupying the great position within the realm.'

sentences.zh: 將撥亂而反正，務在革非。

translations.literal: I shall quell disorder and restore rectitude, striving above all to reform what is wrong.'
translations.idiomatic: I shall quell disorder and restore rectitude, striving above all to reform what is wrong.'

sentences.zh: 期事亡以如存，聿思盡禮。

translations.literal: I expect to treat the dead as if they still lived and think constantly of fulfilling every rite.'
translations.idiomatic: I expect to treat the dead as if they still lived and think constantly of fulfilling every rite.'

sentences.zh: 宜上諡號曰閔宗武靈皇帝。

translations.literal: The honorific title Emperor Minzong Wuling should be conferred.'
translations.idiomatic: The posthumous title Emperor Minzong Wuling should be conferred.'

sentences.zh: 」十八年，有司言：「本朝祖宗尊諡或十八字，或十四字，或十二字，或四字。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the relevant offices stated: 'The honorific titles of the imperial ancestors of our dynasty are either eighteen characters, fourteen characters, twelve characters, or four characters.'
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the relevant offices stated: 'The posthumous titles of our dynasty's imperial ancestors are either eighteen, fourteen, twelve, or four characters in length.'

sentences.zh: 今擬增上閔宗尊諡曰弘基纘武莊靖孝成皇帝，仍加諡悼皇后曰悼平皇后。

translations.literal: It is now proposed to augment Minzong's honorific title to Emperor Hongji Zuowu Zhuangjing Xiaocheng, and to add for Empress Dao the title Empress Daoping.'
translations.idiomatic: It is now proposed to augment Minzong's posthumous title to Emperor Hongji Zuowu Zhuangjing Xiaocheng, and to add for Empress Dao the title Empress Daoping.'

sentences.zh: 」又言：「大定三年追尊睿宗皇帝禮儀，大安殿前立黃麾仗一千人，應天門外行仗二千人，皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，隨冊寶降自西階，搢圭，跪，捧冊寶授太尉。

translations.literal: They stated again: 'In the ritual for posthumously honoring Emperor Ruizong in the third year of Dading, one thousand yellow-banner guards were stationed before Da'an Hall and two thousand outer guards before Yingtian Gate; the emperor wore the tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, followed the registers and seals down the western steps, inserted the jade tablet, knelt, and presented the registers and seals to the Grand Mentor.'
translations.idiomatic: They stated again: 'In the Dading 3 ritual for posthumously honoring Emperor Ruizong, one thousand yellow-banner guards were stationed before Da'an Hall and two thousand outer guards before Yingtian Gate; the emperor wore the tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, followed the registers and seals down the western steps, inserted the jade tablet, knelt, and presented the registers and seals to the Grand Mentor.'

sentences.zh: 今擬大安殿行禮，及依唐、周典故，降階捧冊寶授太尉。

translations.literal: It is now proposed to perform the rite in Da'an Hall and, following the precedents of Tang and Zhou, to descend the steps, hold the registers and seals, and present them to the Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: It is now proposed to perform the rite in Da'an Hall and, following Tang and Zhou precedent, to descend the steps, hold the registers and seals, and present them to the Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 所有冠冕儀仗擬依已行禮例。

translations.literal: All crowns, robes, and ceremonial guards are proposed to follow the ritual precedents already carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Crowns, robes, and ceremonial escorts are to follow the ritual precedents already established.

sentences.zh: 」上命儀仗人數約量減之，餘略同前儀。

translations.literal: ' The emperor ordered that the number of ceremonial guards be reduced by roughly half; the remainder was largely the same as the previous rite.
translations.idiomatic: ' The emperor ordered the ceremonial guard reduced by roughly half; otherwise the rite largely followed the previous one.

sentences.zh: 明年四月十日，奉上冊寶，升祔太廟。

translations.literal: On the tenth day of the fourth month of the following year, the registers and seals were presented and he was enshrined in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the tenth day of the fourth month of the following year the court presented the registers and seals and enshrined him in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，敕再議閔宗廟號，禮官擬上「襄、威、敬、定、桓、烈、熙」七字，奉旨用「熙」字，乃以明年四月一日，遣官奏告太廟及閔宗本室，易新廟號。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, an edict ordered further deliberation on Minzong's temple name; the ritual officials proposed seven characters—'xiang,' 'wei,' 'jing,' 'ding,' 'huan,' 'lie,' and 'xi'—and by imperial order the character 'xi' was adopted; on the first day of the fourth month of the following year officials were dispatched to present memorial announcements at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and at Minzong's own chamber, changing to the new temple name.
translations.idiomatic: In year 26 an edict ordered further deliberation on Minzong's temple name; ritual officials proposed seven characters—xiang, wei, jing, ding, huan, lie, and xi—and by imperial order xi was chosen; on the first day of the fourth month of the following year officials were sent to announce at the Imperial Ancestral Temple and at Minzong's own chamber, adopting the new temple name.

sentences.zh: 大定二十九年四月乙丑，諡大行皇帝曰光天興運文德武功聖明仁孝皇帝，廟號世宗。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the late emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor Guangtian Xingyun Wende Wugong Shengming Renxiao, with the temple name Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month, Dading 29, the late emperor received the posthumous title Emperor Guangtian Xingyun Wende Wugong Shengming Renxiao, with the temple name Shizong.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，以祔廟禮成，大赦。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the fifth month, because the enshrinement rite was completed, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the fifth month, with the enshrinement rite complete, the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 大定二十九年五月甲午，上皇考尊諡曰體道弘仁英文睿德光孝皇帝，廟號顯宗。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month of the twenty-ninth year of Dading, the deceased father was given the posthumous honorific title Emperor Tidao Hongren Yingwen Ruide Guangxiao, with the temple name Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month, Dading 29, the late emperor's father received the posthumous title Emperor Tidao Hongren Yingwen Ruide Guangxiao, with the temple name Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 大定元年二月丁卯，諡大行皇帝曰憲天光運仁文義武神聖英孝皇帝，廟號章宗。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the second month of the first year of Dading, the late emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor Xiantian Guangyun Renwen Yiwu Shensheng Yingxiao, with the temple name Zhangzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the second month, Dading 1, the late emperor received the posthumous title Emperor Xiantian Guangyun Renwen Yiwu Shensheng Yingxiao, with the temple name Zhangzong.

sentences.zh: 正大元年正月戊戌，諡大行皇帝曰繼天興統述道勤仁英武聖孝皇帝，廟號宣宗。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the first month of the first year of Zhengda, the late emperor was given the posthumous title Emperor Jitian Xingtong Shudao Qinren Yingwu Shengxiao, with the temple name Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the first month, Zhengda 1, the late emperor received the posthumous title Emperor Jitian Xingtong Shudao Qinren Yingwu Shengxiao, with the temple name Xuanzong.
